name: Guangdong Construction Engineering Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Guangdong Construction Engineering Group Co., Ltd. operates in the civil engineering and construction industry in China. The company engages in the water conservancy and hydropower facilities, municipal public works, highway projects, mechanical and electrical installation projects, foundation projects, and housing projects.
